skill_name: Summarize the contents of an article about the importance of exercise.
workflow: Maintaining a healthy lifestyle is essential for overall well-being, and exercise is an important part of that. Exercise helps to regulate weight, improve physical strength, reduce stress, and boost energy levels. Additionally, exercise has been proven to provide numerous physical health benefits, which range from better sleep to improved heart health.
